KE-GATEWAY-001.rationale: Reverting an inspection policy restores a known previous configuration, so the action is technically reversible. Its blast radius is bounded to egress traffic but spans every platform routed through the gateway, so recovery must be verified on more than the platform that raised the incident. A successful historical pattern makes the remediation governable; it does not authorise autonomous execution.

profile_coverage_note: Every known error a scenario can select needs a control profile or an explicit exemption. Absent both, the evaluator reports reversibility, blast radius, and policy as failed purely because nobody described the action.
suspension_note: Automation readiness is suspended categorically for any hypothesis not backed by the system's own recorded outcomes. A documented procedure, an analogy from a sibling component, and a peer agent's finding are all legitimate bases for proposing a cause to a human and none of them is evidence that an action works here. Readiness asks whether this system has earned the right to act unattended, and only its own outcome history can answer that.
